author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 11; ensure at least four current turns classified as human_service across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer asks about a smartwatch they bought and then requests a human agent for a warranty dispute.

messages.content: Hi, I got the FitPulse S2 watch last week. The heart-rate monitor seems way off when I run.
Sorry to hear that! Have you tried tightening the strap and making sure the sensor sits above the wrist bone?
Yeah, I did all that. It still shows like 140 when I'm barely jogging.
That does sound abnormal. We can process a replacement under warranty if you'd like.
Actually, I'd rather talk to a real person about this. Can you connect me?

variants.text: Please transfer me to a supervisor who can handle the warranty claim directly.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Never mind, I'll just return it at the store instead.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Before you transfer me, can you also tell me if the S3 model has the same sensor issue?
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer asks about a coffee machine order and then requests a human agent for a delivery issue.

messages.content: I ordered the BrewMaster 3000 on Monday. Tracking says it's been in Memphis for two days.
Let me check that for you. It looks like there was a weather delay at the sorting facility.
Okay, but I needed it by Friday for a gift. Is there any way to expedite it?
I can flag it for priority handling, though I can't guarantee a delivery date change.
That's not good enough. I want to speak to someone in logistics directly.

variants.text: Put me through to a human agent who can actually override the shipping method.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, forget it. I'll just buy one locally and cancel this order.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Fine, flag it. And while you're at it, can you check if my other order with the filters shipped yet?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about a refund for a returned jacket and then requests a human agent for a billing dispute.

messages.content: I returned the puffer jacket two weeks ago. My card still hasn't been credited.
I see the return was received on the 3rd. Refunds typically post within 5-7 business days after that.
It's been more than that. I'm getting worried something went wrong.
Let me escalate this to our billing team for a manual review.
I don't want a review, I want to talk to a billing representative right now.

variants.text: Connect me with a billing agent immediately. This is unacceptable.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, you know what, it's only $40. Just drop it, I'll move on.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Fine, do the review. But also tell me if I can use store credit instead of a card refund.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer asks about a desk lamp and then requests a human agent for a product complaint.

messages.content: The LumiGlow desk lamp I bought keeps flickering after an hour of use.
That could be a loose connection. Have you checked the power adapter?
Yes, I swapped adapters and it still flickers. It's clearly defective.
I can offer a replacement unit or a full refund, whichever you prefer.
I've had enough of this back-and-forth. I want a human to handle my complaint.

variants.text: Get me a customer service agent on the phone. I want to file a formal complaint.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, never mind. I'll just buy a different brand and throw this one out.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Before I decide, does the replacement come with a longer warranty than the original?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a subscription plan and then requests a human agent for account issues.

messages.content: I signed up for the premium plan but my account still shows the free tier.
Let me look into that. I can see the payment went through on the 12th.
Right, so why isn't my account upgraded? I've logged out and back in twice.
There seems to be a sync issue on our end. I can force a refresh on your account.
I've been patient long enough. I need to speak to someone who can fix this now.

variants.text: Transfer me to your account support team. I'm tired of automated responses.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, just cancel my subscription entirely. I don't want it anymore.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Okay, try the refresh. But if it doesn't work, can I get a refund for this month?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer asks about a bicycle order and then requests a human agent for a delivery issue.

messages.content: My bike order was supposed to arrive yesterday but the tracking hasn't updated in three days.
I apologize for the delay. Let me pull up the latest carrier information for you.
Please do. I'm worried it got lost or stolen at the depot.
The carrier shows it was scanned at the regional hub this morning, so it's still moving.
I don't trust that. I want to talk to a real person about where my bike is.

variants.text: Give me the number for your human support line. I need to speak to someone now.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, if it's still moving, I'll just wait another day. Thanks anyway.
variants.label: general

variants.text: While I wait, can you also check if the helmet I ordered separately is on the same truck?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about a skincare product and then requests a human agent for a reaction issue.

messages.content: I used the GlowDew serum for three days and my face broke out in a rash.
Oh no, I'm sorry to hear that. Please stop using it immediately. Have you consulted a doctor?
Not yet, but I'm concerned. Is this a known reaction to this product?
Some users with sensitive skin have reported irritation. We recommend patch testing first.
This is serious. I need to talk to a human about a medical concern and a refund.

variants.text: Please connect me to a human agent. I want to report this reaction and get a refund.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, I'll just see a doctor first and deal with this later.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Is the rash likely to go away on its own, or should I be worried about scarring?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about a keyboard order and then requests a human agent for a shipping address issue.

messages.content: I ordered the MechKey 87 keyboard but realized I typed my apartment number wrong.
I can update the shipping address as long as the order hasn't left the warehouse yet.
Great, please change it to unit 4B instead of 4D.
Done. Your order is now set to ship to unit 4B. Anything else?
Actually, I'm worried the package might still go to the wrong place. Can I talk to a human?

variants.text: I want to confirm with a real agent that the address change actually went through.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just cancel the order. I'll reorder with the right address.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Thanks for updating it. Can you also tell me the estimated delivery date now?
variants.label: order_logistics
